name: eslint-plugin-merit
description: ESLint rules that enforce a Merit ruling rather than a style preference.
//: `typescript-eslint` is a TEST dependency only: RuleTester must parse the files these rules actually run over, which are TypeScript. Under espree a `import type { X } from 'y'` case is a parse error rather than a result, and a rule tested only on the JavaScript subset is a rule whose TypeScript behavior is a guess. It is a `catalog:` reference, so no new version enters the tree.
